data.description: A rat king can communicate with normal rats (including rat swarms and dire rats) as if using speak with animals. It can use Diplomacy to alter a rat's attitude, and when so doing gains a +4 racial bonus on the check. Any ability that allows a creature to communicate with rats (such as speak with animals or a wererat's rat empathy) allows for communication with a rat king.
data.name: Speak with Rats
